summary: Czech tennis player Olga Hostáková Country (sports) Czech Republic Born ( 1975-04-11 ) 11 April 1975 (age 50) Czechoslovakia Turned pro 1992 Retired 2001 Prize money US$ 20,947 Singles Career record 68–66 Career titles 2 ITF Highest ranking No. 336 (18 July 1994) Doubles Career record 47–44 Career titles 5 ITF Highest ranking No. 187 (4 December 1995) Olga Hostáková (born 11 April 1975) is a Czech former tennis player. Hostáková won two singles and five doubles titles on the ITF Circuit in her career. On 18 July 1994, she reached her best singles ranking of world No. 336. On 4 December 1995, she peaked at No. 187 in the WTA doubles rankings. Hostáková made her WTA Tour debut in the doubles draw at the 1995 Warsaw Cup . Her daughters Annika and Kristina Penickova also play tennis. Her brother is a former hockey player Martin Hosták .
